tour.welcomeDesc: Let me walk you through the main features, it only takes a minute. Hit ✕ anytime to skip.
tour.addPlayerDesc:
Tap this button to add players.
Tip: enter several names separated by commas (e.g. An, Binh, Chi) to add them at once.
Add at least 2 players to continue!
tour.addPlayerDone:
This button adds players.
Tip: enter several comma-separated names to add them at once.
tour.scoreDesc:
Enter each player's score for the current round with +/- or by typing.
Key rule: the scores of all players in a round must sum to 0 (winners gain what losers lose).
tour.autoFillDesc:
Tick this for one player and their score is computed automatically as whatever makes the round sum to 0.
No calculator needed!
tour.gapDesc:
This badge is this player's own +/- step size.
Tap it to adjust just for them, without affecting others.
tour.settingsDesc:
Settings that apply to the whole match live here:
• Currency unit
• Global step size
• Compact/full UI
• Light/dark mode
tour.nextRoundTitle: New round — the most important button!
tour.nextRoundDesc:
After each round, enter everyone's scores (sum = 0) and press this to move on.
A match is made of many rounds, so don't cram everything into one.
I'll tag along for your first 3 rounds!
tour.companionDesc:
Keep it up: enter this round's scores (sum = 0) then press New round.
({{round}}/3)
tour.congratsDesc:
First 3 rounds done!
When the game is over, press End match to see the leaderboard and the who-pays-whom map.
Want friends to watch live on their phones? Press Share live at the top for a link or QR code.
Have fun!
